title: What are Actions?
overview: Actions are JavaScript objects that describe an event or change that needs to happen in the Redux state.

title: Action Types
overview: Action types are string constants that identify what kind of state update should be performed.

title: Payload in Actions
overview: Payload contains the data that needs to be sent along with an action to update the Redux state.

title: Action Creators
overview: Action creators are functions that create and return action objects. They make actions reusable and organized.

title: Topic Summary
overview: You learned about Redux actions, action types, payloads, and action creators used for managing state changes.

example.content:
